summary: Iteration 5 backend testing complete. 28/28 tests passing (11 new iter5 + 17 regression). Verified: (1) POST /api/driver/accept now populates driver_start_lat/lng, driver_route_started_at, driver_user_id with offsets within ~1-2km of pickup, (2) auto-assign fallback in progress_trip after 12s also sets these fields, (3) trip messages endpoints — passenger and assigned driver can send/list; unauthenticated=401, unrelated user=403, empty text=400 with 'Melding kan ikke være tom', >500 chars=400 with 'lang', nonexistent trip=404, ordered ascending by created_at, push notification path executes without crash, and full lifecycle passenger↔driver chat works.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1362 lines — well over the 700-line threshold. Strongly recommend modularization (auth, trips, driver, admin, messages, invites, apple, push).

_load_trip_or_403 grants access via driver_id match even when driver_user_id is not set on the trip; this is fine for the current single-driver-per-car model but could allow a driver to read chats of a trip that a colleague later took over. Consider gating strictly on driver_user_id once set.

send_trip_message accesses trip.get('driver', {}).get('name') for push text, but the sender is the driver; the push should identify the driver by their own name (current['fullName']) for consistency with from_name. Minor UX inconsistency, no functional bug.
TripMessageRequest has no maxlength via Pydantic — validation is only in the handler; acceptable but a Pydantic Field(max_length=500) would return a cleaner 422.
Message documents stored without an index on trip_id + created_at; with many trips this list endpoint will scan. Add a compound index in a startup event.
test_credentials: Passenger ola@kjapp.no/test1234, Driver sjafor@kjapp.no/sjafor1234, Admin admin@kjapp.no/admin123 — all verified working.
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_-prefixed trips (Oslo pickup 59.9127,10.7461 -> 59.9110,10.7530) and one TEST_unrelated_* user via /auth/register for the 403 test. No production data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py now contains iter5 classes: TestDriverAcceptPosition, TestAutoAssignFallback, TestTripMessages, TestChatLifecycleRegression. Helper _book_trip + _wait_until_booking simplify future trip-flow tests. Note the auto-assign fallback test takes ~15-20s (waits for 3s search + 12s accept window). Use user_token (trip owner) — NOT admin_token — when polling /api/trips/{id}, since that endpoint filters by user_id. Class-scoped fixture inside TestTripMessages triggers a pytest deprecation warning (non-blocking); can be refactored to module-level fixture later.
